# Creative Formats - project guide

This folder holds five skills in `.claude/skills/`: `/claymation`, `/paper-animation`, `/song-style-ad`,
`/talking-object`, `/skeleton-ads`.

- Load the matching skill when the user asks for that look or that format, or when they type the command.
- Prompts by default. Deliver every script, board and prompt as copy-paste-ready blocks the user runs in
  their own image, video, voice and music tools.
- Before any generation command, name the tool and the model, say that it spends their credits, and wait
  for a yes.
- Do not create or edit files, and do not write a plan, unless the user asks for it.
